leadText: Bonding with Kangaskhan (Japanese: めがはなせないね ガルーラ Keep an Eye on Her, ) is the first episode of the third season of POKÉTOON and eighteenth overall. It was first released in Japan on the official Japanese Pokémon YouTube channel on October 3, 2025, on the official English and western channels on October 24, 2025, and on the French channel on December 9, 2025.

Bonding with Kangaskhan (Japanese: めがはなせないね ガルーラ Keep an Eye on Her, ) is the first episode of the third season of POKÉTOON and eighteenth overall. It was first released in Japan on the official Japanese Pokémon YouTube channel on October 3, 2025, on the official English and western channels on October 24, 2025, and on the French channel on December 9, 2025.

==Blurb==
 Yurado dreams of being a commentator just like her mom. As her mom works, Yurado makes a diorama with Kangaskhan in the next room—and then something mega occurs! 🌟

==Trivia==
This short was shown in French cinemas alongside limited screenings of Pokémon, le film : Volcanion et la merveille mécanique on November 22 and 23, 2025. 

===Dub edits===
The Mainland Chinese upload of this short removes the on-screen credits text during the first part of the credits sequence (with the credits shown alongside drawings and while the epilogue voice-over is going on), and ends before the second part of the credits sequence (with the credits on a black background).
The western uploads add a "POKÉTOON: The Pokémon Cartoon Animation" logo segment at the beginning of the short.
